source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original queue counts pending, waiting and active runners as running. Closing submissions drains queued work before the last runner stops, so running is not a network-activity indicator. Accepted client code exposes a separate idle query and later starts five runners instead of one. Keep these lifecycle and concurrency phases separate; declarations and cleanup waits are not a throughput or cancellation test.
title: EWS client running state includes idle queue workers
